head: 02e968b

verifier.name: phase20-verifier
verifier.verdict: every Build, e2e and Done-when item done; not pass only because CI on 02e968b was red from other agents' layout commits (e241e8f, 1f4753c, 123b3ee) and my full-run xcresult had been overwritten by a later single run

reviews.name: phase20-spec-review
reviews.note: Caught duplicate sub-page row ids (two tabs titled 'zsh ~'), a preview firing after the page was left, and backspace repeats leaving the page.

reviews.name: phase20-ponytail-review
reviews.note: Small trims (one write, rebinds, header moved into the palette); its one should (performKeyEquivalent) failed for shifted keys and was reverted.

reviews.name: phase20-e2e-review
reviews.note: Drove the UI: found the tie order lighting Move Pane Up (two orchestrator decisions followed), the checkmark jumping to a preview, ctrl-tab moving tabs behind the palette, and the untested D41 refusal.

reviews.name: phase20-spec-review-2
reviews.note: Palette commands not in the menu's order, cmd-= untested after its path changed, a sub-page's lit row off-screen (Font Size).

reviews.name: phase20-e2e-review-2
reviews.note: Confirmed the CI pass of the open-panel test; the refusal check could not tell a refusal from an error.

reviews.name: phase20-spec-review-3
reviews.note: scrollTo before the list had a height did nothing: the Font Size fix of round 2 did not work; a flaky key after a page opens.

reviews.name: phase20-e2e-review-3
reviews.note: A 2 s teardown wait and the same flaky key; its slop call on the title helper was wrong (the heading trait changed the value).

notes: About 60 min of GUI lock over 16 local runs (one full make e2e, 18.5 min, 83 green). Time went to the open panel test (four runs: trailing slash, /private vs /tmp, a menu isEnabled wait that never updates while the menu is closed), to SwiftFormat and SwiftLint disagreeing on wrapped trailing closures (a scripted rewrite to action: labels), and to a full run that overlapped a rebuild in the same DerivedData. All 13 palette and key tests passed on CI at 02e968b; that run failed 4 title-row, sidebar and hover-card layout tests from another phase's commits.
